summary: The paper reports Agrp isoform abundance by diet and whole-gene effects of Klf4 deletion. The GEO workbook contains per-sample counts and RPKM. No public author result located in the review measures whole-gene HFD versus chow effects in Cre-negative arcuate nucleus controls, so concordance remains unassessed. The proposal passed validation, and all 46 source-manifest entries passed checksum verification.
openIssues: Figure 1 reports four chow mice. GEO and the registered sample sheet identify three chow controls. The public records do not identify the fourth animal.
A numerical review would require author gene-level diet effects and sample IDs for the Cre-negative controls.
